package.name: nidar_hardware
package.description: The real drone (Jetson Orin Nano + PX4 + Livox Mid-360 + TFmini Plus + camera): sensor drivers and relays that give the NIDAR stack the same topics the simulation provides (/nidar/livox/*, /tfmini/range, /camera/*), the vehicle's static TF from nidar_config/config/hardware.yaml, and the onboard mission commander behind the GCS's TAKEOFF / RTL / LAND. Started by nidar_bringup/scripts/hw_bringup.sh. Simulation never uses it. Needs livox_ros_driver2 (built separately against Livox-SDK2, see hardware/DEPLOYMENT.md); it is not declared below so the simulation workspace builds without it.
